name: faq
title: FAQ
description: Ready made FAQ section on native details and summary, with six layouts, optional search, category tabs, and FAQPage JSON-LD.

props.name: items
props.type: { question: string; answer: string; category?: string }[]
props.description: Questions with plain text answers. category is used by the categories variant.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading (h2). It also names the section landmark.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout. split puts the heading beside the list on wide containers, cards uses a two column grid, searchable adds a filter box, categories adds tabs.

props.name: exclusive
props.description: Only one question open at a time, through a shared name attribute on details.

props.name: schema
props.description: Render FAQPage JSON-LD for search engines.

props.name: contact
props.type: Blade: slot or string · React: ReactNode · Vue: slot or string
props.description: Closing line such as "Still have questions?" with a link.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Label and placeholder of the search box (searchable).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Message announced when the search finds nothing (searchable).

props.name: categoriesLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the category tab list (categories).

a11y: Questions use native details and summary, so Enter and Space open them without JavaScript.
The section is labelled by its heading, and the plus icon is aria-hidden.
The search box has an accessible name and the empty result is announced through a role status region.
Category tabs follow the WAI-ARIA Tabs pattern: arrow keys, Home, and End move between tabs.

ai.whenToUse: A frequently asked questions block on a landing, pricing, or help page.
rules: Keep answers short and plain text; put links in the contact slot
Use searchable for long lists and categories when questions fall into clear groups
Enable schema only once per page, on the main FAQ

id.description: Section FAQ siap pakai dari details dan summary native, dengan enam tata letak, pencarian opsional, tab kategori, dan JSON-LD FAQPage.

props.items: Daftar pertanyaan dengan jawaban teks biasa. category dipakai varian categories.
props.title: Judul section (h2). Juga menjadi nama landmark section.
props.variant: Tata letak. split menaruh judul di samping daftar pada kontainer lebar, cards memakai grid dua kolom, searchable menambah kotak cari, categories menambah tab.
props.exclusive: Hanya satu pertanyaan terbuka, lewat atribut name yang sama di details.
props.schema: Render JSON-LD FAQPage untuk mesin pencari.
props.contact: Kalimat penutup seperti "Masih punya pertanyaan?" dengan tautan.
props.emptyLabel: Pesan yang diumumkan saat pencarian tidak menemukan apa pun (searchable).

a11y: Pertanyaan memakai details dan summary native, jadi Enter dan Spasi membukanya tanpa JavaScript.
Section diberi nama dari judulnya, dan ikon plus diberi aria-hidden.
Kotak cari punya nama aksesibel dan hasil kosong diumumkan lewat region role status.
Tab kategori mengikuti pola Tabs WAI-ARIA: tombol panah, Home, dan End berpindah antar tab.

ai.whenToUse: Blok pertanyaan umum di halaman landing, harga, atau bantuan.
rules: Jawaban singkat dan teks biasa; taruh tautan di slot contact
Pakai searchable untuk daftar panjang dan categories bila pertanyaan terbagi ke kelompok yang jelas
Aktifkan schema sekali saja per halaman, di FAQ utama
